name: What kind of insulation is needed for a garage conversion in the Las Vegas climate?

mainEntity.name: What kind of insulation is needed for a garage conversion in the Las Vegas climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Given the extreme temperatures in the Las Vegas climate, proper insulation is critical for a comfortable and energy-efficient garage-to-bedroom conversion. This includes insulating walls, ceilings, and the garage door opening (if retained or replaced). We typically recommend high-performance insulation materials like spray foam or rigid foam boards to achieve optimal R-values, ensuring the new bedroom remains cool in summer and warm in winter, helping to reduce energy costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-performance insulation (e.g., spray foam) for walls, ceilings, and the garage door opening is crucial in Las Vegas for comfort and energy efficiency.
